subject: maths
title: Parts Parade
description: Integrate by parts using ∫ u dv = uv − ∫ v du.

concepts.def: Choose u from Log, Inverse trig, Algebraic, Trig, Exponential (in order).
Reverse of product rule for differentiation.
May need parts twice (e.g. ∫ x² eˣ dx).
∫ ln x dx → let u=ln x, dv=dx; gives x ln x − x + C.
Evaluate uv between limits, subtract ∫v du between limits.

walkthroughs.body_html:
u=x, dv=eˣdx

du=dx, v=eˣ x eˣ − ∫ eˣ dx = (x−1)eˣ + C

u=ln x, dv=dx

du=dx/x, v=x x ln x − ∫1 dx = x ln x − x + C

u=x, dv=cos x dx

du=dx, v=sin x x sin x − ∫ sin x dx = x sin x + cos x + C
